responsibility: Defines AVR inline-assembly register classes and concrete registers, including paired and pointer register forms, high/low-part modifiers, and overlap rules between 8-bit registers and their 16-bit pair aliases.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/avr.rs`, this AVR file defines inline `asm!` operand registers and classes—single registers, register pairs, pointer forms, `h`/`l` modifiers, and pair/component overlap—rather than call ABI lowering.
